Coerce subject-level images to a canonical (subject by voxel) matrix

Source: R/scale_space_utils.R
as_subject_matrix.Rd

Converts heterogeneous subject-level image inputs into a shared canonical representation used by every subject-level null factory. Accepts a list of 3D arrays or NeuroVols, a 4D array, a NeuroVec, a SparseNeuroVec, or a numeric matrix already in subject-by-voxel form.

Usage

as_subject_matrix(x, mask = NULL, template = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

Input images. One of: list of 3D arrays/NeuroVols, 4D numeric array, NeuroVec, SparseNeuroVec, or a numeric matrix with one row per subject and one column per mask voxel.

mask

Optional logical 3D mask. When NULL, the mask is inferred from the finite intersection across subjects (or, for SparseNeuroVec, from the intrinsic mask). When supplied, the mask is used exactly: any voxel inside it that is non-finite in the input is an error.

template

Optional 3D template carrying spatial metadata. Required only for the matrix branch when mask does not already supply dimensions.

...

Additional arguments (currently unused; reserved for future per-branch options).

Value

An object of S3 class "neurothresh_image_matrix" with components:

X

n_subjects x n_mask numeric matrix.

mask

3D logical array, or LogicalNeuroVol when input carried NeuroSpace metadata.

mask_idx

Integer vector of mask voxel positions in column-major order.

template

3D template volume (array or NeuroVol).

dims

Integer length-3 dimensions.

coords

n_mask x 3 numeric matrix of array indices.

space

NeuroSpace if available, else NULL.

source

Character: "list", "neurovec", "sparseneurovec", "array4d", or "matrix".
